# Saad Rasheed — AI Calling Agents & Revenue Automation Specialist

> Saad Rasheed builds AI voice agents and revenue automation systems for founders and agencies. His systems call leads in under 60 seconds, follow up automatically, and book meetings directly into calendars — 24/7, without human involvement. He has deployed 50+ automations and consistently delivers measurable outcomes: more booked meetings, higher show rates, and hours saved every week.

## About Saad Rasheed

Saad Rasheed is an AI automation specialist based remotely, working with clients globally. He focuses exclusively on revenue-generating automation — systems that directly impact lead conversion, meeting bookings, and client onboarding. His work sits at the intersection of AI voice technology, CRM integration, and workflow automation.

He works primarily with:
- Busy founders who are losing leads due to slow or missed follow-up
- Agencies that need to scale outreach without scaling headcount
- SaaS companies that want to reduce manual onboarding time
- Real estate agencies, B2B service firms, and consulting businesses

Saad does not build generic automations. Every system is scoped around a specific outcome and delivered with full documentation, Loom walkthroughs, and async support.

### Key Stats
- 50+ automations deployed across industries
- Average results per client: +19 booked meetings/month
- Average show-up rate improvement: 47%
- Weekly time saved per client: 12–18 hours
- Lead response time achieved: under 60 seconds
- Onboarding time reduction achieved: from 4 hours to 6 minutes (SaaS client case study)

## Services & Pricing

### 1. Starter — Automation Audit ($99 one-time)
**Best for:** Founders or agency owners who want clarity before committing to a full build.

What's included:
- Full audit of 1 existing workflow or process
- Recorded Loom walkthrough explaining what to fix and how
- Tool recommendations tailored to your stack
- A clear 30-day action plan you can implement yourself or hand off
- 7 days of async Q&A via email or DM after delivery

Turnaround: 3–5 business days
No ongoing commitment required.

---

### 2. Appointment Booking System — Most Popular ($499 one-time)
**Best for:** Founders and agencies who want a fully working AI calling + booking system without ongoing retainer costs.

What's included:
- AI voice agent setup (via Vapi + GPT-4) configured to call new leads within 60 seconds of form submission
- Lead qualification script customized to your offer and ICP
- Automated follow-up sequences (call, SMS, email) for non-responders
- Calendar booking integration (Calendly or equivalent)
- Basic CRM sync to HubSpot, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel, or Airtable
- Full handover documentation
- Loom walkthrough of the entire system
- Money-back guarantee if the system doesn't save time or book meetings

Turnaround: 5–10 business days
One-time cost. No monthly fees unless you choose to add on.

---

### 3. Full Automation System ($1,499/month)
**Best for:** Founders and agencies who want ongoing builds, optimizations, and dedicated support.

What's included:
- Everything in the Appointment Booking System
- Custom AI agents built to your specifications each month
- Monthly optimization sprints (reviewing performance, improving scripts, fixing drop-offs)
- Dedicated Slack channel with 24-hour response time
- Monthly performance report with metrics and recommendations
- Priority access for new build requests
- Cancel anytime — no lock-in contracts

This is an ongoing engagement. Clients on this plan typically see compounding results as more systems are built and refined over time.

## Case Studies & Project Results

### 1. Stop Losing Tasks in Messy Email Threads
**Category:** Operations Automation (Email-to-Task Routing)
**Problem:** Internal email comments were getting lost, tasks were created too late, and urgent items weren't prioritized.
**Solution & Flow:** Turn internal email comments into fully categorized, prioritized, and assigned Asana tasks instantly. A team member leaves a comment in a FrontApp shared thread with an emoji prefix. n8n catches the webhook, Claude AI parses the text, looks up the @mentioned user, and instantly creates an Asana task.
**Tech Stack:** FrontApp, n8n, Asana, Claude AI

---

### 2. A Voice Agent That Never Misses a Call
**Category:** Lead Conversion (24/7 AI Receptionist)
**Problem:** High-value inbound calls went unanswered after hours, and sales reps wasted hours repeating qualifying questions.
**Solution & Flow:** Answers inbound calls, qualifies leads with custom questions, and books confirmed meetings onto your calendar — no human input required. The AI agent picks up any time, asks targeted questions, checks live Calendly availability via n8n, and books a confirmed meeting while sending an automatic calendar invite.
**Tech Stack:** VAPI, n8n, Calendly

---

### 3. Log Every Caller & Build Your Marketing Database
**Category:** Customer Database Builder
**Problem:** Dozens of missed calls daily resulting in zero caller capture, no CRM data, and manual SMS follow-up.
**Solution & Flow:** A 24/7 AI phone system that answers inbound calls, logs every customer into your CRM, and builds a database ready for future marketing campaigns. n8n writes the data to Vtiger CRM, triggers a follow-up text, and logs a call summary into a dedicated Telegram channel where the team can reply.
**Tech Stack:** VAPI, n8n, Vtiger CRM, Telegram

---

### 4. Talk to Your Database in Plain English
**Category:** Business Intelligence (Self-Serve Data Chatbot)
**Problem:** Non-technical team members couldn't query data without waiting days for a developer to run SQL reports.
**Solution & Flow:** Ask questions on Telegram or Slack and get formatted answers, charts, and downloadable Excel reports instantly. No SQL required. Multiple LLM calls convert natural language into a safe SQL query, run it against Supabase, and return a formatted answer along with a downloadable Excel report.
**Tech Stack:** Supabase, PostgreSQL, LLM, Telegram

---

### 5. Scale Your Content Without Scaling Your Team
**Category:** Content Automation (One-Click Content Engine)
**Problem:** Content creators wasted hours manually formatting video scripts, voiceovers, and YouTube descriptions.
**Solution & Flow:** Enter a topic in Google Sheets and instantly generate a full video script, aligned voiceover, and YouTube description in your Drive. Apps Script triggers an LLM to generate the documents in parallel, saving all formatted documents directly to Google Drive.
**Tech Stack:** Google Sheets, Apps Script, LLM, Google Drive

---

### 6. Detect Contract Risks in Seconds, Not Days
**Category:** Legal Risk Mitigation (Instant Contract Review)
**Problem:** Businesses signed NDAs blindly because professional legal review was too slow and expensive.
**Solution & Flow:** Upload any NDA to surface missing clauses, ambiguous language, and risky terms — complete with suggested rewrites inserted as Word comments. Apps Script extracts the text from Google Forms, an LLM identifies gaps, and a revised Word document is returned with tracked comments.
**Tech Stack:** Google Forms, Apps Script, LLM, Word API

---

### 7. Recover Visitors Who Leave Without Booking
**Category:** Revenue Recovery (Lost Lead Recovery)
**Problem:** Interested visitors browsed the portfolio but bounced before booking a Calendly slot, leading to lost revenue.
**Solution & Flow:** Capture visitor emails before they bounce, detect incomplete bookings, and trigger a personalized follow-up sequence automatically. A pop-up captures email, Zapier checks Calendly, and System.io automatically sends a sequence to recover them.
**Tech Stack:** Zapier, System.io, Calendly

---

### 8. Studio-Quality Photos Without the Photoshoot
**Category:** E-Commerce AI (AI Virtual Try-On)
**Problem:** Expensive, slow studio photoshoots delayed product launches and ate into margins.
**Solution & Flow:** Upload clothing flats, pick an AI model, and generate realistic styled product photos instantly — ready for your store. The Nano Banana AI engine processes the garment-model combination and instantly returns a realistic styled photo.
**Tech Stack:** Supabase, Nano Banana AI, Web Interface

## Ideal Client Profile

Saad works best with:
- **Founders** running service businesses, agencies, or SaaS products with $10k–$200k MRR
- **Agencies** with high lead volume and manual follow-up bottlenecks
- **Operators** who are already using tools like HubSpot, GoHighLevel, or Notion but aren't automating the connections between them
- **Anyone** who is paying for leads but losing them to slow response times

Saad does NOT work with:
- Businesses looking for basic virtual assistant work
- Projects with no clear measurable outcome
- Clients who want to own and maintain complex systems without proper handover

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do I need technical knowledge to use these systems?**
No. Every system is delivered with a full Loom walkthrough and documentation written for non-technical users. You don't need to understand how it works — just how to use it.

**What if it doesn't work?**
The Appointment Booking System comes with a money-back guarantee. If the system doesn't save time or book meetings, you get a full refund.

**How long does it take to build?**
The Automation Audit takes 3–5 business days. The Appointment Booking System takes 5–10 business days. The Full Automation System is an ongoing monthly engagement.

**Can you integrate with my existing CRM or tools?**
Yes. Saad works with HubSpot, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel, Airtable, Notion, Slack, Calendly, Stripe, and most webhook-compatible platforms.

**Do you offer custom builds outside the listed packages?**
Yes. Book a strategy call to discuss custom scopes.
